dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Well, in my free time, I like to clear my mind and listen to the lyre or the ukulele.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Even solo, the sound is almost dreamlike in its beauty, so pure and sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Some emerging styles even incorporate drums or other stringed instruments to add a stronger beat and a more robust sound.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: In comparison, that kind of music is more like a gripping, vibrant dream, full of energy and passion... Listening to it can feel so intense, it can tire you out or even make you dizzy.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if I'm sensitive to music in general, or if I like music because, like dreams, it's full of different genres, flavors, and emotions...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Whatever the answer, I think it's important to be introspective about these things.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Anyway, I never found the time to pick up an instrument myself... Are you a musician by any chance?

choices.text: Of course! Quite a talented one at that!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can teach you if you want!

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I should have known... You remind me of a bard sometimes, you know. There's a certain musical cadence to the way you speak...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I'm sure taking lessons from you would be quite a therapeutic process...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: I think I'll take you up on that offer... Maestro.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Please be patient with me if I'm a slow learner.

choices.text: I'm not very good. Maybe we could learn together!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have a few ideas of where to start...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Sounds good! I'll leave it to you, then.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Learning something new with a friend will be an experience to remember! The sooner we learn, the sooner we can start playing our favorite songs...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: If we perform together, I bet we could produce something with a whole new kind of "flavor"... I'm looking forward to it!

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Here's to our musical journey, fellow student!
